description: Read-only: check one node (or, with recursive:true, its whole sub-network) for cook/compile errors and warnings. Pass `summary:true` for grouped counts instead of the full list. Returns {total, errors[] or by_type}. For a large network prefer summarize_td_errors, which clusters errors by shared cause and points at the worst-offending nodes.

path.description: Full path of the node (or network root) to check for errors.

recursive.description: If true, check the whole network under `path`; otherwise just that node.

summary.description: Return only counts grouped by error type instead of the full error list.

name: get_td_node_errors

by_type.description: summary mode: count of errors grouped by error type.

errors.description: Full mode: each error/warning with its node path, type and message.

path.description: The node or network root that was checked, echoing the request.

total.description: Total number of errors/warnings found (0 means clean).

title: Get node errors
